scope: Read-only source-model validation of all manifest PPRs; not scanner/vendor compilation or biological validation.

calibration_contract.read_scale_note: PPR represents the acquired gradient DAC calibration; this checker does not apply an extra read-axis scale.

timer_arg_policy: Raw signed-narrowing timer_arg flags are reported. They are not alone a failure when mapped wait duration is within the inherited unsigned 0..65500 range and the mapper reports no timer_overrun.

timer_arg_context.purpose: Raw timer_arg signed-narrow diagnostics are compared with inherited PPL paths and interpreted as 16-bit unsigned only as context; no timer_arg-only failure is asserted.
